description:
## Outcome

        Jidoka has portable trusted registration and binding contracts that connect an extension request to reviewed code identity, permissions, capabilities, and mode limits.

        ## Why now

        An ID-only request is safe but unusable until the host can prove what code and permissions it represents. This record is also the durable identity for resume and fork.

        ## Current state

        No extension registry exists. CLI runtime profiles do not record source, version, hash, trust, permissions, or automation compatibility. Pi packages show the value of replaceable extensions, but Pi warns that packages run with full system access; Jido must add a stronger record.

        ## Ownership and boundary

        This is a `jidoka` contract change. Embedding hosts and the CLI supply trusted registrations. Agent data supplies requests only. Raw process commands can exist in trusted host configuration, but never in the portable Jidoka registration projection or durable binding.

        ## Detailed implementation

        1. Add versioned `Registration`, `Identity`, `PermissionSet`, `CapabilitySet`, and portable `Binding` contracts.
2. Record stable extension ID, source type, source reference, version, content hash, trust state, granted permissions, supported modes, protocol version, and declared capabilities.
3. Define built-in and process descriptor classes without storing live module/function/process values in the portable projection. Keep live factories in the injected registry only.
4. Add a resolver that matches requests to enabled trusted registrations and validates ID, hash, version, permissions, mode, and configuration schema.
5. Reject unknown, disabled, unpinned, changed, over-permissioned, or mode-incompatible registrations before session start.
6. Define binding identity rules for resume and fork.

        ## Acceptance criteria

        - [ ] A valid request resolves to one trusted binding and minimal granted permissions.
- [ ] Unknown, duplicate, disabled, untrusted, hash-mismatched, or unpinned records fail closed.
- [ ] Automation rejects an interactive-only registration.
- [ ] Portable binding contains no command, module, function, PID, secret, or host path.
- [ ] Resume rejects changed identity or permission grants.
- [ ] Policy gate receives the resolved permission and capability summary.

        ## Test plan

        - Success: resolve built-in and process-shaped fake registrations in interactive and automation modes.
- Invalid input: duplicate ID, bad hash, version mismatch, invalid permission, and config-schema failure.
- Runtime failure: resolver or registry lookup failure becomes a typed startup error.
- Boundary and security: permission escalation, changed pin on resume, interactive-only automation, and nonportable binding.
- Deterministic capability: in-memory registry, fixed hashes, IDs, and clocks.
- JSONL and exit status: portable binding projection JSON-encodes and redacts private descriptor data.

        ## Documentation

        Add the extension identity, trust, permission, and binding contract to an extension architecture guide. Contrast request data with trusted registration data.

        ## Non-goals

        Do not load a process. Do not add package installation or signatures. Do not add project trust UI. Do not define lifecycle events yet.

        ## Dependencies

        Blocking issues:

        - `jido_cli-tqg.4.1` — Add data-only extension requests to agent documents
- `jido_cli-tqg.3.1` — Gate every external effect with authoritative host policy

        Features unlocked by this story:

        - Versioned extension lifecycle events
- Built-in and process extension hosts
- CLI project trust records

        ## Commit plan

        Create exactly one focused `jidoka` commit. Use a message such as `feat(jidoka): define trusted extension bindings (jido_cli-tqg.4.2)`. Do not include another backlog feature.

        ## Verification commands

        ```sh
        cd /Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_cli/jidoka
mix test test/jidoka/extension/registration_test.exs test/jidoka/extension/resolver_test.exs
mix quality
mix test
mix docs
        ```
title: Define trusted extension identity and permission bindings
